metadata.purpose: Geometric disambiguation of confused hand signs: Tiger/Ram, Serpent/Dragon

coordinate_system.y: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge (y increases downward)
coordinate_system.note: All values are MediaPipe normalized (0-1 range, un-mirrored camera space)

tiger.pattern_notes: Index: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=-0.0014) | Middle: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=0.0161) | Right extends: [thumb,index,middle] | Left extends: [thumb,index,middle] | >>> TIGER PATTERN CONFIRMED: both hands at same height

ram.pattern_notes: Index: LEFT HAND HIGHER (avg Δ=0.1061) | Middle: LEFT HAND HIGHER (avg Δ=0.1171) | Right extends: [thumb,index,middle] | Left extends: [thumb,index,middle] | >>> RAM PATTERN CONFIRMED: left hand consistently above right

serpent.pattern_notes: Index: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=0.0102) | Middle: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=0.0166) | Right extends: [thumb] | Left extends: [thumb] | Thumb: SYMMETRIC (Δ=0.0212) | >>> SERPENT: look for fingertips pointing downward (low height_above_mcp values)

dragon.pattern_notes: Index: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=-0.0482) | Middle: SYMMETRIC (avg Δ=-0.0415) | Right extends: [thumb] | Left extends: [thumb] | >>> DRAGON: look for compact palm (low wrist spread) and short finger extension
